
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/axing/p/19099985" title="发布于 2025-09-19 01:48">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">OpenCvSharp基于颜色反差规避FBA面单贴标</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><strong>0</strong><strong class="autonum" title="" data-original-title="">1</strong></p>
<p>规避原理</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">1.抠图，根据色差或者根据固定包裹位置以及包裹尺寸抠出纸箱图片</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">2.色差，获取纸箱上所有背景色的灰度值</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">3.采图，采集大量视野相同，光源相同面单的色差灰度值，整理区间</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">4.取反，所有非面单灰度值区间的，都认为是纸箱背景色</p>
<strong>0</strong><strong class="autonum" title="" data-original-title="" data-num="3">2</strong><ol class=" list-paddingleft-2">
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">根据DPI计算1mm对应像素点。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">获取吸取的颜色，计算灰度值</p>
</li>
</ol>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">&nbsp;</p>
<pre class="_135editor code-snippet_nowrap" data-tools="135编辑器" data-role="code" data-language="csharp" data-theme="vs" data-warp="0" data-line="0" data-wrap="0"><code>// 300 DPI 计算：每毫米像素数 = 300 / 25.4 ≈ 11.81<br>private const double PixelsPerMm = 300.0 / 25.4 ;<br>private static int LabelSizePixels = Convert.ToInt32(Math.Ceiling((int)(95 * PixelsPerMm) / 1.7)); // 100mm × 100mm<br><br>// 面单颜色列表（十六进制格式）<br>private static readonly List&lt;string&gt; LabelColors = new List&lt;string&gt;<br>{<br>	"#E2E2E0", "#DEDEDC", "#E0E0DE", "#CCCCCA", "#B2B2B0", "#C2C2C0","#FFFFFF","#FEFEFE","#FCFCFC" ,"#ADADAD"<br>};<br><br>// 计算出的面单灰度范围<br>private static int MinLabelGray;<br>private static int MaxLabelGray;</code></pre>
<pre class="_135editor code-snippet_nowrap" data-tools="135编辑器" data-role="code" data-language="csharp" data-theme="vs" data-warp="0" data-line="0" data-wrap="0"><code>// 加载图像<br>var originalImage = Cv2.ImRead(@"D:\Users\steph\Pictures\1分4\Image_20250913210539498.jpg", OpenCvSharp.ImreadModes.Grayscale);<br><br>// 计算面单灰度范围<br>CalculateLabelGrayRange();<br>Console.WriteLine($"计算出的面单灰度范围: {MinLabelGray}-{MaxLabelGray}");<br><br><br>if (originalImage.Empty())<br>{<br>	Console.WriteLine("无法加载图像");<br>	return;<br>}</code></pre>
<p>此处用第二种最简单方式演示，视野固定包裹位置，根据计算包裹的尺寸，扣除原箱外观</p>
<pre class="_135editor" data-tools="135编辑器" data-role="code" data-language="csharp" data-theme="vs" data-warp="0" data-line="0"><code>// 从右下角裁剪图像<br>private static OpenCvSharp.Mat CropImageFromBottomRight(OpenCvSharp.Mat image, double widthMm, double heightMm)<br>{<br>	// 将毫米转换为像素<br>	int widthPixels = (int)(widthMm * PixelsPerMm/1.7);<br>	int heightPixels = (int)(heightMm * PixelsPerMm/1.7);<br><br>	// 获取图像尺寸<br>	int imgWidth = image.Cols;<br>	int imgHeight = image.Rows;<br><br>	// 计算裁剪区域的左上角坐标<br>	int x = Math.Max(0, imgWidth - widthPixels);<br>	int y = Math.Max(0, imgHeight - heightPixels);<br><br>	// 确保裁剪区域不超出图像边界<br>	widthPixels = Math.Min(widthPixels, imgWidth - x);<br>	heightPixels = Math.Min(heightPixels, imgHeight - y);<br><br>	// 检查裁剪区域是否有效<br>	if (widthPixels &lt;= 0 || heightPixels &lt;= 0)<br>	{<br>		Console.WriteLine($"无效的裁剪区域: x={x}, y={y}, width={widthPixels}, height={heightPixels}");<br>		return image.Clone(); // 返回原始图像的副本<br>	}<br><br>	Console.WriteLine($"裁剪区域: x={x}, y={y}, width={widthPixels}, height={heightPixels}");<br><br>	// 裁剪图像<br>	return new OpenCvSharp.Mat(image, new Rect(x, y, widthPixels, heightPixels));<br>}</code></pre>
<p>根据裁切后的原箱外观，以及灰度值区间，定位原厂面单位置</p>
<pre class="_135editor" data-tools="135编辑器" data-role="code" data-language="csharp" data-theme="vs" data-warp="0" data-line="0"><code>// 检测所有原厂面单位置<br>public static List&lt;LabelPosition&gt; DetectOriginalLabelPositions(OpenCvSharp.Mat image)<br>{<br>	var labelPositions = new List&lt;LabelPosition&gt;();<br><br>	// 二值化图像以分离面单区域<br>	var binary = new OpenCvSharp.Mat();<br>	Cv2.Threshold(image, binary, MinLabelGray, 255, ThresholdTypes.Binary);<br><br>	// 形态学操作去除噪声<br>	var kernel = Cv2.GetStructuringElement(MorphShapes.Rect, new OpenCvSharp.Size(5, 5));<br>	Cv2.MorphologyEx(binary, binary, MorphTypes.Open, kernel);<br><br>	// 查找轮廓<br>	Cv2.FindContours(binary, out var contours, out _, RetrievalModes.External, ContourApproximationModes.ApproxSimple);<br><br>	// 过滤轮廓（按面积）<br>	var filteredContours = contours.Where(c =&gt; Cv2.ContourArea(c) &gt; 1000).ToList();<br><br>	// 处理每个轮廓<br>	foreach (var contour in filteredContours)<br>	{<br>		// 获取轮廓的边界矩形<br>		var rect = Cv2.BoundingRect(contour);<br><br>		// 转换为网格坐标<br>		string gridCoordinate = ConvertToGridCoordinate(rect, image.Rows, image.Cols);<br><br>		// 计算实际尺寸（毫米）<br>		double widthMm = rect.Width / PixelsPerMm;<br>		double heightMm = rect.Height / PixelsPerMm;<br><br>		// 添加到结果列表<br>		labelPositions.Add(new LabelPosition<br>		{<br>			Rect = rect,<br>			GridCoordinate = gridCoordinate,<br>			WidthMm = widthMm,<br>			HeightMm = heightMm<br>		});<br>	}<br><br>	return labelPositions;<br>}</code></pre>
<br>
<p>检查可贴标签位置是否与原厂标签有交集，检查可贴区域是否超过原箱尺寸，此处我们以新帖面单大小100mm*100mm为例。没有可贴标签位置默认选择1-1位置贴标</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">// 查找可贴标签的位置（与原厂标签无交集的网格）
public static List&lt;string&gt; FindAvailableLabelPositions(OpenCvSharp.Mat image, List&lt;LabelPosition&gt; labelPositions)
{
	var availablePositions = new List&lt;string&gt;();

	// 获取图像尺寸
	int rows = image.Rows;
	int cols = image.Cols;

	// 计算网格行列数
	int gridCols = (int)Math.Ceiling((double)cols / LabelSizePixels);
	int gridRows = (int)Math.Ceiling((double)rows / LabelSizePixels);

	// 检查每个网格位置是否可用
	for (int row = 1; row &lt;= gridRows; row++)
	{
		for (int col = 1; col &lt;= gridCols; col++)
		{
			// 计算当前网格的像素坐标
			int x1 = Math.Max(0, cols - col * LabelSizePixels);
			int y1 = Math.Max(0, rows - row * LabelSizePixels);
			int x2 = Math.Min(cols, x1 + LabelSizePixels);
			int y2 = Math.Min(rows, y1 + LabelSizePixels);

			// 确保区域足够大
			if (x2 - x1 &lt; LabelSizePixels / 2 || y2 - y1 &lt; LabelSizePixels / 2)
				continue;

			// 创建网格矩形
			Rect gridRect = new Rect(x1, y1, x2 - x1, y2 - y1);

			// 检查网格是否与任何原厂标签相交
			bool intersects = false;
			foreach (var labelPos in labelPositions)
			{
				if (gridRect.IntersectsWith(labelPos.Rect))
				{
					intersects = true;
					break;
				}
			}

			// 如果不相交且区域颜色均匀，则添加到可用位置
			if (!intersects &amp;&amp; IsAreaUniform(image, x1, y1, x2, y2))
			{
				availablePositions.Add($"{row}-{col}");
			}
		}
	}

	return availablePositions;
}
</pre>
</div>
<p>　　</p>
<pre class="_135editor" data-tools="135编辑器" data-role="code" data-language="csharp" data-theme="vs" data-warp="0" data-line="0"><code>&nbsp;</code></pre>
<p>可视化结果，以绿色网格铺满原箱，以红色区域标定原厂标签位置，以蓝色网格标定可贴标签位置，返回可视化结果</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">// 可视化结果
public static OpenCvSharp.Mat VisualizeResults(OpenCvSharp.Mat image, List&lt;LabelPosition&gt; labelPositions, List&lt;string&gt; availablePositions)
{
	var colorImage = new OpenCvSharp.Mat();
	Cv2.CvtColor(image, colorImage, ColorConversionCodes.GRAY2BGR);

	int rows = image.Rows;
	int cols = image.Cols;

	// 绘制网格
	for (int x = 0; x &lt; cols; x += LabelSizePixels)
	{
		Cv2.Line(colorImage, new OpenCvSharp.Point(x, 0), new OpenCvSharp.Point(x, rows), Scalar.Green, 2);
	}
	for (int y = 0; y &lt; rows; y += LabelSizePixels)
	{
		Cv2.Line(colorImage, new OpenCvSharp.Point(0, y), new OpenCvSharp.Point(cols, y), Scalar.Green, 2);
	}

	// 标记所有原厂面单位置（红色）
	foreach (var labelPos in labelPositions)
	{
		Cv2.Rectangle(colorImage,
					 labelPos.Rect.TopLeft,
					 labelPos.Rect.BottomRight,
					 Scalar.Red, 2);

		// 添加标签文本
		Cv2.PutText(colorImage,
				   labelPos.GridCoordinate,
				   new OpenCvSharp.Point(labelPos.Rect.X, labelPos.Rect.Y - 5),
				   HersheyFonts.HersheySimplex,
				   0.5,
				   Scalar.Red,
				  2);
	}

	// 标记可贴标签位置（蓝色）
	foreach (var pos in availablePositions)
	{
		var parts = pos.Split('-');
		if (parts.Length != 2) continue;

		int row = int.Parse(parts[0]);
		int col = int.Parse(parts[1]);

		int x = Math.Max(0, cols - col * LabelSizePixels);
		int y = Math.Max(0, rows - row * LabelSizePixels);
		int width = Math.Min(LabelSizePixels, cols - x);
		int height = Math.Min(LabelSizePixels, rows - y);

		if (width &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; height &gt; 0)
		{
			Cv2.Rectangle(colorImage,
						 new OpenCvSharp.Point(x, y),
						 new OpenCvSharp.Point(x + width, y + height),
						 Scalar.Blue, 2);

			// 添加标签文本
			Cv2.PutText(colorImage,
					   pos,
					   new OpenCvSharp.Point(x + 5, y + 15),
					   HersheyFonts.HersheySimplex,
					   0.4,
					   Scalar.Blue,
					   1);
		}
	} 
	return colorImage;
}
</pre>
</div>
